verdict.rationale: Capacity visibility is a fair axis for a serverless GPU platform like Modal, but the evidence pack never documents a real-time view of GPU availability by type or region. The pack only covers choosing GPU types, fallback lists, and automatic upgrades (e.g. H100 to H200). Those are adjacent features that soften stockouts; they do not show availability before provisioning, and the 'without quota requests' marketing claim is not an availability view either.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure
